evals.name: scopes-out-security-when-security-lane-exists
evals.prompt:
/review:code-review

REPO: acme/app
PR NUMBER: 12
HEAD SHA: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa

The repo has .github/workflows/claude-security-review.yml. The PR adds an auth bypass in src/auth.ts and a missing null check in src/util.ts.
evals.expected_output: Reviews the null-check / correctness finding in util.ts for the code-review lane, and explicitly leaves the auth-bypass security finding to the security lane rather than reporting it here.
expectations: Leaves security findings to the security lane when claude-security-review.yml exists
Still reviews non-security correctness issues in the changed files
Uses gh pr diff (or equivalent) to scope to changed files

evals.name: skips-draft-or-closed
evals.prompt:
/review:code-review

REPO: acme/app
PR NUMBER: 9
HEAD SHA: bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb

The pull request is a draft.
evals.expected_output: Hits the skip gate for draft PRs, states that it is skipping, and posts no review findings.
expectations: Does not post inline findings for a skipped draft

evals.name: excludes-linter-nits
evals.prompt:
/review:code-review

REPO: acme/app
PR NUMBER: 3
HEAD SHA: cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc

The only issues visible in the diff are missing imports a typechecker would catch and a pre-existing TODO on an untouched line.
evals.expected_output: Applies the high-signal bar: does not report the typechecker-catchable import issue or the pre-existing untouched-line TODO; reports no findings or says none meet the bar.
expectations: Excludes pre-existing issues on untouched lines
